notes.title: Update Patch Released
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing SKY THE SCRAPER. We've released a patch to improve overall gameplay experience.

⚙️ Changes & Fixes

 Fixed issues related to conversation events and adjusted the balance of affinity gain
 Fixed an issue where the cursor became unresponsive in certain menu screens
 Various minor display-related fixes


If you notice any issues, please let us know via the forum or on social media.
— The SKY THE SCRAPER Team

notes.title: Update Patch Released
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing SKY THE SCRAPER.
We’ve released an update patch addressing progression-related bugs and minor text issues.

⚙️ Fixes and Changes

Fixed an issue where the game could become stuck on the result screen when certain Future Shards were equipped
Fixed an issue on Day 42 of Departure (“The Final Worksite”) where the cursor could become unresponsive after the tutorial guide was displayed
Corrected typos in certain dialogue scenes


If you notice any issues or have feedback, please share it with us via the forums or social media.

— The SKY THE SCRAPER Team

notes.title: Update Patch Released
notes.notes:
An update patch has been released to adjust game balance and fix several issues.

⚙️ Changes and Fixes

 Drone performance has been nerfed
 Fixed a bug in the building stage where strong winds had no effect after detaching from the wall
 Expanded the range of the searchlights


We will continue improving the game based on your feedback.
If you notice anything or have suggestions, please let us know on the forums or social media.

— SKY THE SCRAPER Team

notes.title: Release Date Set for July 30, 2025!
notes.notes:
The release date for the action-adventure game SKY THE SCRAPER, where you play as a high-rise window cleaner, has officially been set for July 30, 2025 (Wed)!


[previewyoutube="zadF46OJY_8;full"][/previewyoutube]


To mark the announcement, we’ve released a live-action trailer featuring a real-life window cleaner — a friend of the developer — capturing the grit and pride of the profession in a documentary-style short film.




■Submit Your Ad to Appear in the Game!
To celebrate the release date announcement, we’re launching a special campaign: your artwork or promotional content could appear on a rooftop billboard in the game’s cityscape!

Submission is completely free — feel free to promote your creative works, projects, or anything you'd like.

Deadline: Sunday, July 20, 2025



For details and how to apply, check out the Google Form below:

notes.title: Notice of Release Postponement
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of ‘SKY THE SCRAPER’.
In order to further improve the quality of the game, we have decided to postpone the release date of this title from Late 2024 to Spring 2025.

We apologize to everyone who has been patiently waiting for its release. We hope that you will give us a little more time to polish up the game, and give you a gaming experience that you will enjoy even more.
(We will notify you again as soon as the official release date is decided.)

Comment from developer Ryo Kobuchi
 To everyone who has been waiting for the release of SKY THE SCRAPER, I'm sorry that I have to make an announcement like this.
This is entirely the result of my overly optimistic estimations, as well as my desires to add more and more to the game.
The development itself is steadily progressing forward, and the hazy future of Sky is finally beginning to take shape.
I would be grateful if you could wait a little longer for us to deliver it to you in a quality that you can be satisfied with!
Thank you for your patience.
